conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Martin from Amazon Security. I'm calling because we detected an unusual purchase on your account today.
Oh, uh, I wasn't expecting anything from Amazon. What kind of purchase?
It's showing a MacBook Pro for $2,149, set for overnight delivery to an address in Texas. Did you authorize this order?
No, absolutely not. I haven't bought anything like that.
Alright, please don't worry. We take these matters seriously. To help you resolve this, I need to verify your identity. Could you confirm your full name as it appears on your Amazon account?
Uh, yeah, it's Lisa Turner.
Thank you, Ms. Turner. For additional security, may I have the email address linked to your account?
It's lisaturner78@gmail.com.
Thank you. Now, before I proceed to cancel this unauthorized order, are you accessing your account from your home Wi-Fi or mobile data currently?
I'm on my home Wi-Fi. Look, my son needs me, can we make this quick?

Absolutely, I understand. We're almost done. As part of the secure resolution process, Amazon security will place a temporary hold on your account to prevent further fraudulent activity. You'll receive a code via SMS in a moment, could you please read it back to me?
Okay, just got it... it's 483920.

Perfect, thank you. This helps us block unauthorized access. Now, to finalize the cancellation, our system requires a secure verification deposit. This is a standard step for high-value order disputes.
A deposit? What does that mean? I just want this canceled.

I completely understand, Ms. Turner. The deposit is only a verification that will be refunded immediately. It ensures the dispute is filed under your name and not the hacker's. It's just $499, which protects your account and stops shipment.
That sounds weird. How do I do that?

To keep your information secure, Amazon uses digital gift cards for verification purposes. You can purchase an Amazon gift card for $499 at any major store, Walmart, Walgreens, or CVS, and read me the code. I will process the refund and cancellation right away.
You want me to buy a gift card and give you the numbers?
Yes, that's correct. This method is used so the funds are not exposed to the hacker. Once the code is entered, the transaction is flagged and your money is refunded.
I mean, I guess I could do it in a bit. But is this really safe?

Absolutely, Ms. Turner. I am here to protect your account, and this process is monitored by Amazon's fraud department. As soon as you provide the code, you will receive a reimbursement confirmation by email.
Okay, so I just need to get the card and call you back?
You can stay on the line if you prefer, or call us at the secure Amazon customer support number I'm sending you. Please remember not to share this code with anyone else for your own protection.
Alright, I'll try to grab the card after I check on my mom.
Thank you, Ms. Turner. Take your time. Your account is on hold, so no further charges will occur. Please let me know as soon as you have the card, and I'll help you finish the cancellation.
Okay, thanks. I'll call back soon when I have it.
You're most welcome. We're here to help, and your security is our priority.
